name: tiered-rates-editor
title: Tiered rates editor
description: Edit price breaks, shipping bands or commission tiers: ranges that chain automatically, so there are never gaps or overlaps.
docs: Pass the tiers as value ([{ from, rate }], first to last) with onValueChange. A tier ends one below where the next begins, so the To column is worked out and never typed, and the last row says 'and up'. The first tier starts where yours does and stays; every other From must lie between its neighbours, and a number that would make a tier end before it starts is refused with the reason in words: the cell keeps its last good number. A start is judged when typing pauses, when the cell is left and on Enter, so a number on its way ('7' before '75') is never refused; only one that more digits cannot repair (above the next tier's start) is refused at once. The reason replaces the note under the table while it is shown, and the band is kept as tall as the longest reason needs, so nothing moves. Below 20rem of width the Tier column is left out (the fields keep their names by row) so the table fits a small phone. Add appends a tier at a round number about twice the last start, with no rate yet; removing a tier hands its range to the one before it (the first tier's range goes to the next). With a currency the rate is money in minor units (cents), without one a plain number with rateSuffix after it. unit takes a word or { one, other }, rateLabel names the column and starts the note, minRows and maxRows limit the table, and labels translates the words.
